notes.title: MAX MUSTARD NOW AVAILABLE ON STEAM!
notes.content:
We're thrilled to announce that Max Mustard is out NOW on Steam!
Experience the award-winning VR platformer that's critically acclaimed on mobile and console VR platforms.

Completely upgraded and optimized for PC, Max Mustard on Steam includes:
- 40 levels made for VR
- Improved visuals for PC
- Wide range of headset support

So what are you waiting for? Jump into nostalgic 3D platforming like never before thanks to immersive VR! Enter the vibrant world of Max Mustard and see it for yourself!
